version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release through ReaPack. A MIDI sampler: load a MIDI phrase, map it across the keyboard and shape it with a note filter, an envelope, warping and looping, in classic, one-shot, slice or granular mode.

metadata.description: {\pard Midular\par A MIDI sampler. Load a MIDI phrase, map it across the keyboard, and shape it with a filter, an envelope, warping and looping - every stage works on notes, not audio.\par Put an instrument after it: it emits MIDI. Use the Midular Import script to load a phrase from MIDI items or a MIDI file.\par }

version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release through ReaPack. Imports MIDI into Midular: run it with MIDI items selected to capture them, or with nothing selected to pick a MIDI file. The phrase goes straight into the open Midular.

metadata.description: {\pard Midular - Import MIDI\par Imports MIDI into Midular.\par Run it with one or more MIDI items selected to capture them, or with nothing selected to pick a MIDI file from disk.\par }
